# Third-party libraries

- **[SDL3](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL)** - window, input, and platform abstraction
- **[glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad)** - OpenGL loader
- **[glm](https://github.com/g-truc/glm)** - math library (vectors, matrices, quaternions)
- **[cgltf](https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf)** - single-header glTF 2.0 parser
- **[stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb)** - single-header image loading/writing (stb_image, stb_image_write)
- **[bc7enc](https://github.com/richgel999/bc7enc_rdo)** - BC1-BC7 texture compression
- **[mikktspace](https://github.com/mmikk/MikkTSpace)** - tangent space generation for normal mapping
- **[imgui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui)** - immediate-mode GUI
- **[imguizmo](https://github.com/CedricGuillemet/ImGuizmo)** - transform gizmo built on top of ImGui
- **[doctest](https://github.com/doctest/doctest)** - lightweight C++ unit testing framework
- **[nanobench](https://github.com/martinus/nanobench)** - microbenchmarking
- **[wyhash](https://github.com/wangyi-fudan/wyhash)** - fast hash function
- **[yyjson](https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson)** - fast JSON parser and writer
